fix for whole-page main-loop freeze (surface acquired but not presented); see out/freeze evidence. javap -p -c -s -constants of the baseline class (sha256 = beforeSha256) and of the candidate class (sha256 = afterSha256), CRLF removed, constant-pool indexes and instruction offsets normalised, compared member by member (out/integ8/javap); two static int fields (presentCount, presentCountAtLoopBoundary) and eight methods are added (9 -> 11 fields, 48 -> 56 methods) and two methods change. swapWindow gains presentCount++ at its start. presentYield wraps the unchanged yieldAfterPresent call in a catch (RuntimeException) that, for the same non-threading suspension refusal (new isNonThreadingSuspension), calls recordSkippedPresentYield (a @JSBody counter, globalThis.__gaiusSkippedPresentYields) and otherwise rethrows. The new loopBoundary() returns at once when HostLoop.jspi() is true (WebAssembly GC/JSPI build), when presentCount differs from presentCountAtLoopBoundary (a frame was presented since the previous boundary; the mark is updated) and when HostLoop.inNoSuspendFrame() is true; otherwise it yields one timer turn (@Async yieldLoopTurn through yieldLoopTurn(AsyncCallback), its lambda and the @JSBody scheduleLoopTurn, setTimeout(resume, 0)), swallows only the same refusal and counts the yield (recordLoopBoundaryYield, globalThis.__gaiusLoopBoundaryYields). Every other method, field, flag and annotation is unchanged.
